Based on the provided context, only Citigroup (C) disclosed specific figures for technology spending in 2023. The bank stated it invested over $12 billion in technology in 2023. This investment was part of a broader transformation effort where roughly 30% of investments over the last three years were in technology, with the remainder related to non-tech employees and consultants. In 2023, Citigroup noted a shift from consulting expenses toward technology and compensation as it moved deeper into execution. Regarding general and administrative (G&A) or total expenses, Citigroup reported full-year expenses of $54.3 billion for 2023 (excluding the FDIC special assessment and divestiture-related impacts), which included approximately $780 million in restructuring costs and $730 million in additional severance costs.

The provided context does not contain information regarding technology spending or G&A expense changes for Wells Fargo, Capital One, or Bank of America for 2023 or 2024.
